sources.title: Aviam - The Ancient Synagogues at Baram.pdf
sources.inspection_scope: Image-only 12-page sideways scan; OCR entire scan read, including pp155–171 and figure/caption spread; key paragraphs visually recoverable.
sources.change_assessment: Late underfloor coin group; rolled bronze amulet under later construction; tunnel function unverified. Late comparanda, not Copper Scroll identification.

sources.title: Kohn-Tavor and Arubas 2023 - The Synagogue at Korazim - New Insights and a Reassessment.pdf
sources.inspection_scope: Complete supplied chapter body pp34–39 read from extraction, front matter seen; bibliography heading present but no bibliography entries.
sources.change_assessment: A possible early synagogue rests on architectural fragments reused/scattered, not excavated early building; small chamber treasury function remains interpretation.

sources.title: Magness et al. 2023 - The Huqoq Synagogue Excavations - Report on the 2011-2018 Seasons.pdf
sources.inspection_scope: Only opening printed p48 plus front matter in supplied extraction; rest pp49–65 absent.

sources.title: Bonnie, Hakola and Tervahauta (editors) 2021 - The Synagogue in Ancient Palestine - Current Issues and Emerging Trends.pdf
sources.inspection_scope: Full-volume text available; targeted Stern Prayer as Power pp221–229 with references inspected; other chapters keyword-screen only.
sources.change_assessment: Inscribed bronze concealments and interpretive alternatives can be catalogued separately from hoards; Stern Baram report depends on Aviam, not independent find.

sources.title: Weiss and Netzer 1996 - Promise and Redemption - A Synagogue Mosaic from Sepphoris.pdf
sources.inspection_scope: Full-volume readable extraction obtained; introductory construction/date paragraph inspected, printed page not confirmed; rest keyword-screen only.
sources.change_assessment: Early fifth-century mosaic/building date based on underfoundation coins per preliminary authors; no earlier stage reported. No candidate change.

sources.title: State of Israel 2014 - The Necropolis of Bet Shearim - A Landmark of Jewish Renewal.pdf
sources.inspection_scope: Full UNESCO nomination text obtained; targeted catacomb inventory/descriptions pp25–38 and restatement pp58–63 inspected; management/remainder unreviewed.
sources.change_assessment: Courtyard/built-threshold cave plans useful morphological comparanda; main necropolis later than Scroll. Reuse/damage cautions matter to floor/datum tests.

sources.title: Aviam, Kuwabara, Hasegawa and Paz 2019 - A 1st-2nd Century CE Assembly Room (Synagogue?) in a Jewish Estate at Tel Rekhesh, Lower Galilee.pdf
sources.inspection_scope: Supplied article text pp128–142 read; captions inspected; native figure images not yet visually audited.
sources.change_assessment: Benched room dimensions and northern entrance are observations; synagogue function and pre70 construction are author inference; connection to northern complex unexcavated.

sources.title: Onn 1994 - The Ancient Synagogue at Kafr Misr.pdf
sources.inspection_scope: Full supplied article text/captions/references pp117–134 inspected; malformed OCR in finds catalogue tables; native figures unreviewed.
sources.change_assessment: Drainage channel beneath benches/portico/northern presumed entrance is dated to late synagogue phases, not first-century ceramics; morphology does not establish contemporaneity.

sources.title: Dar and Mintzker - The Synagogue of Horvat Sumaqa, 1983-1993.pdf
sources.inspection_scope: Entire supplied chapter text pp157–165 inspected including figure captions; plates cited but not present/audited.
sources.change_assessment: Six-coin Byzantine group under L286 slabs is reported with latest coin618/619; stageII function unresolved. Out-of-window deposit comparator.

sources.title: Har-Even 2013 - Horvat Diab - A Rural Settlement with a Second Temple Period Synagogue in Western Benjamin.pdf
sources.inspection_scope: Substantive readable Hebrew body pp23–38 inspected plus bibliographic tail pp39–42; native plans/captions not visually audited.
sources.change_assessment: Actual preserved northern threshold and nearbath plan supplies rural assembly comparator. Coins from sealing collapse date site activity, not precise construction of each wall/cave.

sources.title: Magen, Tzionit and Sirkis - Qiryat Sefer - A Jewish Town and Synagogue from the Second Temple Period.pdf
sources.inspection_scope: All12nativePDFcapturepages visually inspected; printedpp25–32 available; all screenshotjoins not independently certified, so complete original-line coverage remains unverified.
sources.change_assessment: Two hoards correspond existingCHRE8172/8173: primary BuildingIII bedrockcrevice and BuildingV easternroom juglet descriptions. Earlier centralroom wording differs current threshold-provenance account; preserve source-specific descriptions, no duplicate row.

sources.title: Onn and Weksler-Bdolah - Khirbat Umm el-Umdan - A Jewish Village with a Second Temple Period Synagogue in Modiin.pdf
sources.inspection_scope: All14nativePDFcapturepages visually inspected; printedpp107–116 available; screenshotjoin continuity not fully certified.
sources.change_assessment: Separate Seleucid/Hasmonean/Herodian hall and bath phases, partially explored underlying rockcutrooms; reportedFirstRevolt coincontext versus proposed66CE event association requires locus-level dating verification. No eligible hoard reported.

sources.title: Zissu and Ganor 2009 - Horvat Ethri - A Jewish Village from the Second Temple Period and the Bar Kokhba Revolt in the Judean Foothills.pdf
sources.inspection_scope: Complete text/captions obtained; substantive pp90–107 plus conclusion109–110 inspected; parts108–109 incompletely reviewed; native pp99/102/118/123/125/133 visually verified; figures111–136 rendered privately.
sources.change_assessment: New primary descriptions replace generic lack of Ethri archaeological contexts, but do not establish identity of unread2012 title-hoard. Two wall-corner groups, floor-niche single coin, systemXIV half-shekel and reuse-controlled hiding units must remain separate.
